notes: «أخيه علي بن مهزيار» : أخيه plus a name is one link (rule 7).
The last level holds the two narrators of the story, Isma'il and al-Arqat («ابن عم أبي عبد الله» is a description).
Abu Abdullah speaks in the story («صدقت»; the words after «ارتدع»), and the rules do not settle whether he is the last link or the narrators are, so this is a ruling case.
